what_to_do.en: Tap the word that is spelled right.

stages.choice_rule: Four unique spellings of one same suffixed word. Exactly one is the standard Grade 2 spelling. The other three are misspellings of that same word: wrong doubling, kept or dropped silent e, y not changed to i, or extra or missing suffix letters. Never use a different real word as a distractor. Shuffle so the right choice is not always first.

gold_items.stem: Make this box look big with er
The turtle moves slow with ly
<NAME> said the bag feels heavy with er

roots: Every item has one right spelling and three misspellings of that same suffixed word.
Never use a different real word, a different suffix meaning, or a wordlist typo such as happi or allways as the correct choice.
Tier 1 targets just-add suffixes on unchanged bases: ed, ing, or s. Make distractors obvious: missing letters or a doubled suffix.
Tier 2 targets drop-silent-e or double-the-final-consonant before ed, ing, or er. Distractors should miss exactly that change.
Tier 3 targets y-to-i before ed or er, and ly adverbs. Distractors keep y, add the wrong vowel, or misspell ly.
Stay in the Grade 2 suffix set only: s, es, ed, ing, er, est, ly, ful, less.
Keep stems in kid world: school, home, food, pets, play, family, weather. No brands and no real names.

tier_rules.1: Short stems of three to six words. Just add s, ed, or ing. Distractors drop letters or pile on extra suffix letters.
tier_rules.2: Stems of four to eight words. Use drop-silent-e or double-final-consonant before ed, ing, or er. Distractors miss that one change.
tier_rules.3: Longer stems up to ten words. Use y-to-i before ed or er, or add ly. Distractors are near-miss spellings of the same word.

add_ed.en: Add -ed to tell about the past. Keep the other letters the same.
add_ed.ko: 과거를 말할 때는 -ed를 붙입니다. 다른 글자는 그대로 둡니다.

add_ing.en: Add -ing to the word. Keep the base letters the same.
add_ing.ko: 단어에 -ing을 붙입니다. 원래 글자는 그대로 둡니다.

add_s.en: Add -s to mean more than one. Do not add extra letters.
add_s.ko: 하나보다 많으면 -s를 붙입니다. 글자를 더 넣지 마세요.

add_es.en: After s, x, ch, or sh, add -es to mean more than one.
add_es.ko: s, x, ch, sh 뒤에는 하나보다 많음을 -es로 나타냅니다.

drop_e.en: Drop the silent e, then add the suffix.
drop_e.ko: 말하지 않는 e를 빼고 나서 접미사를 붙입니다.

double_consonant.en: Double the last consonant, then add the suffix.
double_consonant.ko: 마지막 자음을 하나 더 쓴 다음 접미사를 붙입니다.

add_er.en: Add -er to compare two things. Double the last consonant in a short word.
add_er.ko: 두 가지를 비교할 때는 -er을 붙입니다. 짧은 단어는 마지막 자음을 겹칩니다.

add_est.en: Add -est to compare more than two. Double the last consonant if you need to.
add_est.ko: 셋 이상을 비교할 때는 -est를 붙입니다. 필요하면 마지막 자음을 겹칩니다.

add_ly.en: Add -ly to tell how. Do not change the other letters.
add_ly.ko: 어떻게인지 말할 때는 -ly를 붙입니다. 다른 글자는 바꾸지 마세요.

y_to_i.en: Change the y to i, then add the suffix.
y_to_i.ko: y를 i로 바꾼 다음 접미사를 붙입니다.
